Illustrative showcase — read this. REAL data, not this project's model: these are reanalysis-class ocean surface currents — OSCAR L4 v2.0 total (geostrophic + Ekman) surface currents, NASA PO.DAAC / Earth & Space Research, DOI 10.5067/OSCAR-25F20 — measured-and-derived from satellite observations, NOT computed by planet-sim's models (this project renders the field; it did not produce it). This is a TIME series — twelve monthly snapshots (one day per month), 2020, 12 frames — and the globe crossfades between frames, heavily time-accelerated (one year compressed to ~30 s); the streaming particles are illustrative: they trace each frame's snapshot velocity, not actual water parcels, and the smooth morph between frames is interpolation, not resolved day-to-day flow. The velocity is the average over the top 30 m of the mixed layer. Land and unobserved cells (~48% of the grid, including the poles beyond ±89.75° and anywhere lacking data in ANY frame) carry no data and no particles.
